heading: INT. ROLLER DERBY LOCKER ROOM - NIGHT

units.text: INT. ROLLER DERBY LOCKER ROOM - NIGHT
Dented lockers, benches strewn with kneepads, a cracked mirror reflecting a banner reading "BRUISE BROTHERS."
Cheers from the arena thud through the wall, then fade.
COACH VIOLET HARGROVE (50s, headset around her neck) stands with her arms folded.

Her team sits in a half-circle: CHERRY BOMBSHELL (20s, helmet cradled in her lap), TANK TOMASELLI (30s, taped wrist), JUNIPER KWAKU-REED (20s, ice pack on her jaw), and OLD SALLY (40s, towel over her head).
Nobody speaks.
A loose locker door swings and clangs.
Cherry picks at a thread on her glove.
Tank stares at his wrist.
Juniper adjusts the ice pack, winces, and puts it back.
Old Sally slowly lifts the towel, looks at Violet, and lowers it again.
Violet unfolds her arms, crosses to the whiteboard, picks up a marker, caps it, and sets it down.
That's it.
units.name: VIOLET

units.text: Coach...
units.name: CHERRY

units.text: ^Coach...
units.name: TANK

units.text: They stop.
Violet doesn't turn.
Showers. Bus in twenty.
units.name: VIOLET

units.text: Old Sally stands first.
She tucks the towel under her arm and walks out without looking at anyone.
Juniper follows, dragging her skates.
Tank lingers by the door and tips his chin at the whiteboard.
Cherry lays her helmet on the bench, very carefully, as if it might wake.
